text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Japan Cup, a myriad of 
voices filled the packed racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Who would've thought Vivlos would 
actually run in the Japan Cup!”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She won the Takarazuka Kinen, sure, but 
how will she do today, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it's gotta be Kitasan Black! 
Her ability is a cut above the rest, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You can't count out Satono Crown either! 
After all, she's got experience racing 
overseas.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand and Vivlos... Following the 
Victoria Mile, it's another sister 
showdown. However...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand hasn't really stood out, and 
with a lineup like this, I wonder how 
Vivlos will do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Alongside their immense brilliance, there 
are also those who doubt them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos-chan, Cheval-chan! Give it all 
you've got, both of you~!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm so proud of how you two push each 
other to be better! No matter who wins—I'm 
proud of both of you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I believe in you. All of you... my 
beloved, pride-worthy little sisters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a profound love, believing in the 
two of them more than anyone else. 
And—that love reaches them, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
There might not be that many people who 
truly believe in us.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I know. I know how amazing you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So…… Let's run with all our might. True to 
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I know for a fact that you're 
strong, Cheval-chi!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I've known for a long time now. Getting to 
run against a Cheval-chi who's truly 
giving it her all—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
My heart is pounding just as hard as it 
did for you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, why don't we tell everyone? To all 
the people around the world!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"That we are one super-duper amazing 
family! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Can you give me some too, Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without saying another word, Vivlos stares 
intently at me. It's her signature 
pleading look.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: W-Why? ...Did you not like it?
choice_data_list:
Because then it'll just sound like I only 
said it because you asked me to.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: I believe in you with all my heart.
I believe in you with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list:
Let's win today and head to Dubai next 
year!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you have the very best reward 
ready for me, okay?♡
